answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 157305 Country: INDIA Title: My mother who is 61 years old want to perform Hajj but I don't get the leave for 40 days, so please confirm she can go with her niece & niece’s husband or any other way to perform Hajj without mahram. We can't go through private due to financial problem. Question: My mother who is 61 years old want to perform Hajj but I don't get the leave for 40 days, so please confirm she can go with her niece & niece’s husband or any other way to perform Hajj without mahram. We can't go through private due to financial problem. Answer ID: 157305 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 424/365/B=3/1439) The husband of nawasi is mahram for the woman. Hence it is lawful to go with him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
